title: Retro TV Emulator Website building
author: RetroTVEmulator
selftext: My Retro TV Emulator allows you to take your downloaded media and in one app do the following. Media player/emulation/DVD player on channel 03, TV guide on channel 04, and 05-44 are TV stations/music visualizer station that organize your videos and music into scheduled media. Emulating the CRT TV experience from channels to menus while simulating Cable stations so the channels can be used. There is no coding required to set anything up. I am moving along. everything has been moved to GitHub and setup on the website, website is built except the tutorial section coming soon (need to make the video and finish filling in the text). The build is in Alpha stage and once we confirm all is built and no bugs we will move to Beta for long term testing. right now its being tested by me and my discord members. We have updates up and running. Server options are next on the get up and running list (greyed out for now coming soon). I'm expecting bugs after merging everything into one hub for better information exchange, scan improvements, adding in holiday bezels, expanding options, and more. no heavy testing yet on the latest build because I have been working on the website but will be doing that soon before moving on. With updates working I am hoping that doesn't matter to much. i made sure it did what its suppose to do before posting it. but 2 days later, a week later, a different computer, that is when the bugs stick out. if you wanna track our progress or give it a try check out the website, it has the build, source code, and discord link.
